blocks.content: 1. FIRST UNDERSTAND WHAT PARA JUMBLES REALLY TEST

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Finding the central idea and the independent opening sentence forms the foundation for reordering jumbled paragraphs.
Identifying mandatory pairs using pronoun tracking, repeated keywords, and connectors is the single most powerful solving skill.
Logical flow relies heavily on chronological order, contrast structures, and sentence tone matching.
Utilizing option elimination allows competitive exam aspirants to solve Para Jumble questions within 20 seconds.

items: Sentences containing contrast conjunctions (however, but) or standalone pronouns (he, she, it, they) almost never start a paragraph.
Focus on locating 'Mandatory Pairs' to eliminate 2-3 options instantly in SSC exam multiple-choice questions.
Watch out for common traps where chronological signals or tone matches are subtly violated.
